title: MP: Why Are Adivasis Protesting in Balaghat? 27 Children’s Deaths Raise Questions
ground_truth: Adivasis are protesting in Balaghat, Madhya Pradesh, due to the deaths of 27 children.
official_record: The video reports on protests by Adivasi communities in Balaghat, Madhya Pradesh, following the deaths of 27 children, raising questions about the circumstances.
